scope: real Apple Virtualization VM; throwaway Vault repository; AI work simulated by Shell commands

checks.name: the Vault's committed state goes into the VM
the Shell works in /workspace on the task branch; uncommitted and ignored files stayed out
the AI changes, commits, runs a script from the workspace and leaves one change uncommitted
the browser opens workspace files read-only
checks.title: Workspace page

checks.name: the workspace survives a VM restart and is selected again
the work comes back to a hidden ref with uncommitted changes committed; nothing is a branch yet
approval makes the branch nidus/<task>; the user's branch and edits are untouched
a task without changes brings nothing back
a second import with the same task name is refused (work is never overwritten)
